lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Hold your choice against an upsell
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: politely insist on your order, explain your budget, and decline a pricier suggestion
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: The server keeps steering you toward the most expensive fish; hold your choice politely and explain your budget.
lessons.title: Keep Your Lunch Choice Within Budget
lessons.objective: Decline a repeated suggestion for expensive fish, explain a lunch budget and keep the original choice politely.
lessons.focus: Use je préfère, mon budget est de, c’est au-dessus de mon budget and je vais garder mon choix to hold a clear decision.
lessons.scene: At a lunch restaurant, Maya has chosen the fixed-price lunch, while the server suggests a pricier fish twice.

cards.fr: Je préfère le plat du jour.
Mon budget est de vingt euros.
Le poisson est au-dessus de mon budget.
cards.en: The fish is over my budget.

cards.fr: Non merci, je vais garder mon choix.
cards.en: No thank you, I will keep my choice.

cards.fr: Quel est le prix du plat du jour ?
cards.en: What is the price of the daily special?

cards.fr: Je prends le plat du jour, s’il vous plaît.
cards.en: I will have the daily special, please.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Quel est le prix du plat du jour ?
reader.en: Hello. What is the price of the daily special?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Dix-huit euros. Je vous conseille aussi notre poisson à trente-deux euros.
reader.en: Eighteen euros. I also recommend our fish at thirty-two euros.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci, mais mon budget est de vingt euros. Je préfère le plat du jour.
reader.en: Thank you, but my budget is twenty euros. I prefer the daily special.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Le poisson est vraiment notre meilleur plat.
reader.en: The fish really is our best dish.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Je comprends. Il est au-dessus de mon budget, alors je vais garder mon choix.
reader.en: I understand. It is over my budget, so I will keep my choice.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Très bien. Vous prenez le plat du jour ?
reader.en: Very good. Will you have the daily special?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui, le plat du jour, s’il vous plaît.
reader.en: Yes, the daily special, please.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: D’accord. Je vous apporte le plat du jour.
reader.en: All right. I will bring you the daily special.

speaking.opening: Bonjour. Quel est le prix du plat du jour ?
speaking.goal: Ask the daily-special price, decline the expensive fish twice, explain the twenty-euro budget and confirm the original order.
speaking.closure: Merci. Je garde le plat du jour.
wordBank: Je préfère le plat du jour.
Mon budget est de vingt euros.
Le poisson est au-dessus de mon budget.
Non merci, je vais garder mon choix.
Quel est le prix du plat du jour ?
Je prends le plat du jour, s’il vous plaît.

see.cueEnglish: Find the phrase for the fixed-price lunch.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to state a twenty-euro budget.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the polite refusal that keeps the choice.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for budget.

say.cueEnglish: Explain that the fish exceeds the budget.

write.cueEnglish: Write an order for the daily special.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The prices and restaurant recommendation are fictional. Review register for the second polite refusal; distinguish the daily special from a separate fixed-price formula.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: ask when locals eat, how long lunch lasts, coffee after meals, and afternoon closures
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Ask a local why restaurants close at 3 p.m. and what counts as normal at a weekday lunch.
lessons.title: Ask a Local About Weekday Lunch
lessons.objective: Ask a local when people nearby eat lunch, how long lunch lasts, whether coffee follows and why some restaurants close mid-afternoon.
lessons.focus: Use vers quelle heure, combien de temps, après le repas and rouvrir le soir to ask about a local routine without asserting a universal rule.
lessons.scene: Maya asks a local colleague about a typical weekday lunch in this neighborhood.

cards.fr: Vous déjeunez vers quelle heure ici ?
cards.en: About what time do you eat lunch here?

cards.fr: Combien de temps dure le déjeuner ?
Vous prenez un café après le repas ?
cards.en: Do you have coffee after the meal?

cards.fr: Pourquoi ces restaurants ferment à quinze heures ?
cards.en: Why do these restaurants close at three p.m.?
Do they reopen in the evening?

cards.fr: La cuisine ferme après le service de midi.
cards.en: The kitchen closes after lunch service.

cards.fr: Le samedi, les horaires sont différents.
cards.en: On Saturday, the hours are different.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Vous déjeunez vers quelle heure ici, un jour de semaine ?
reader.en: About what time do you eat lunch here on a weekday?

reader.speaker: Local
reader.fr: Dans ce quartier, nous commençons souvent vers midi et demi.
reader.en: In this neighborhood, we often start around half past noon.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Combien de temps dure le déjeuner ?
reader.en: How long does lunch last?

reader.speaker: Local
reader.fr: Pour moi, environ quarante-cinq minutes. Et je prends parfois un café après le repas.
reader.en: For me, about forty-five minutes. And I sometimes have coffee after the meal.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pourquoi ces restaurants ferment à quinze heures ?
reader.en: Why do these restaurants close at three p.m.?

reader.speaker: Local
reader.fr: Leur cuisine ferme après le service de midi. Certains rouvrent le soir.
reader.en: Their kitchen closes after lunch service. Some reopen in the evening.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le samedi, c’est pareil ?
reader.en: Is it the same on Saturday?

reader.speaker: Local
reader.fr: Pas toujours. Les horaires changent selon le restaurant.
reader.en: Not always. Hours vary by restaurant.

speaking.opening: Vous déjeunez vers quelle heure ici, un jour de semaine ?
speaking.goal: Ask when and how long the local colleague lunches, whether coffee follows, and why nearby restaurants close at three p.m.
speaking.closure: Merci. Je vérifierai les horaires du restaurant.
wordBank: Vous déjeunez vers quelle heure ici ?
Combien de temps dure le déjeuner ?
Vous prenez un café après le repas ?
Pourquoi ces restaurants ferment à quinze heures ?
La cuisine ferme après le service de midi.
Le samedi, les horaires sont différents.

see.cueEnglish: Find the phrase for a weekday.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to ask how long lunch lasts.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the question about closing at three.

type.cueEnglish: Type the word for to reopen.

say.cueEnglish: Ask whether coffee follows the meal.

write.cueEnglish: Write a question about evening reopening.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The local’s times and explanations are fictional neighborhood-specific replies; review cultural accuracy without generalizing all French lunch customs.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Build a picnic at a deli
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: order sliced foods by quantity, ask for packing and utensils, and ask where picnics are allowed
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Put together a picnic for four at a deli counter and ask where you're allowed to eat it in the park.
lessons.title: Build a Picnic for Four at a Deli
lessons.objective: Order sliced food and bread by quantity for four people, request packing and utensils, and ask where a park picnic is allowed.
lessons.focus: Use grammes, tranches, emballer, des couverts and où peut-on pique-niquer to assemble and carry a specific order.
lessons.scene: At a deli counter, Maya puts together a picnic for four before walking to a nearby park.

cards.fr: Je voudrais deux cents grammes de jambon en tranches.
cards.en: I would like two hundred grams of sliced ham.

cards.fr: Et deux cent cinquante grammes de fromage.
cards.en: And two hundred fifty grams of cheese.

cards.fr: Vous pouvez tout emballer pour un pique-nique ?
cards.en: Can you pack everything for a picnic?

cards.fr: Il nous faut des couverts et des serviettes.
Où peut-on pique-niquer dans le parc ?
cards.en: Where may we picnic in the park?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. C’est pour un pique-nique de quatre personnes.
reader.en: Hello. It is for a picnic for four people.

reader.speaker: Deli worker
reader.fr: Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut ?
reader.en: What do you need?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Deux cents grammes de jambon en tranches et deux cent cinquante grammes de fromage.
reader.en: Two hundred grams of sliced ham and two hundred fifty grams of cheese.

reader.speaker: Deli worker
reader.fr: Très bien. Vous voulez du pain avec ?
reader.en: Very good. Would you like bread with that?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui, quatre petits pains. Vous pouvez tout emballer ?
reader.en: Yes, four small rolls. Can you pack everything?

reader.speaker: Deli worker
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Je mets aussi des serviettes et des couverts dans le sac.
reader.en: Of course. I will also put napkins and cutlery in the bag.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Où peut-on pique-niquer dans le parc voisin ?
reader.en: Thank you. Where may we picnic in the nearby park?

reader.speaker: Deli worker
reader.fr: Sur les pelouses indiquées près de l’entrée, d’après le panneau du parc.
reader.en: On the marked lawns near the entrance, according to the park sign.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Parfait. Nous lirons le panneau en arrivant.
reader.en: Perfect. We will read the sign when we arrive.

speaking.opening: Bonjour. C’est pour un pique-nique de quatre personnes.
speaking.goal: Order measured sliced foods and four rolls, request packing and cutlery, then ask where the nearby park permits picnics.
speaking.closure: Merci. Nous lirons le panneau du parc.
wordBank: Je voudrais deux cents grammes de jambon en tranches.
Et deux cent cinquante grammes de fromage.
Vous pouvez tout emballer pour un pique-nique ?
Il nous faut des couverts et des serviettes.
Où peut-on pique-niquer dans le parc ?

see.cueEnglish: Find the French phrase for two hundred grams.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for cutlery.

say.cueEnglish: Order the sliced ham by weight.

write.cueEnglish: Write a question about picnic locations in the park.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The park sign and picnic area are fictional; qualified review should verify French quantity agreement and park-rule language without asserting a general permission.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: alert staff, ask someone to call emergency services, and say what was eaten
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Your friend starts reacting after a bite of street food; alert the vendor, ask for emergency help, and say what was eaten.
lessons.title: Ask for Emergency Help During an Allergic Reaction
lessons.objective: Alert a street-food vendor that a friend is having an allergic reaction, ask someone to call emergency services and report what the friend ate.
lessons.focus: Use une réaction allergique, une allergie aux cacahuètes, le médicament and appelez le 112 to report exactly what happened and ask direct questions.
lessons.scene: After one bite of a taco at a market food stall, Elena tells Maya her throat feels tight and she is having an allergic reaction to peanuts.

cards.fr: Mon amie fait une réaction allergique.
cards.en: My friend is having an allergic reaction.

cards.fr: Elle a mangé une bouchée de ce taco.
cards.en: She ate one bite of this taco.

cards.fr: Dites aux secours ce qu’elle a mangé.
cards.en: Tell emergency services what she ate.

cards.fr: Tu as besoin de ton médicament ?
Elle a mangé ce taco il y a cinq minutes.
cards.en: She ate this taco five minutes ago.

cards.fr: Elena a une allergie aux cacahuètes.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Aidez-nous, s’il vous plaît ! Mon amie fait une réaction allergique.
reader.en: Help us, please! My friend is having an allergic reaction.

reader.speaker: Vendeur
reader.fr: Que s’est-il passé ?
reader.en: What happened?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Elena a une allergie aux cacahuètes. Elle a mangé une bouchée de ce taco. Elle a la gorge serrée.
reader.en: Elena has a peanut allergy. She ate one bite of this taco. Her throat feels tight.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Tu as besoin de ton médicament ?
reader.en: Do you need your medicine?

reader.speaker: Elena
reader.fr: J’ai déjà utilisé mon médicament. Il était dans mon sac.
reader.en: I have already used my medicine. It was in my bag.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pouvez-vous appeler le 112, s’il vous plaît ?
reader.en: Can you call 112, please?

reader.speaker: Vendeur
reader.fr: J’appelle le 112 maintenant.
reader.en: I am calling 112 now.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: La sauce contient des cacahuètes ?
reader.en: Does the sauce contain peanuts?

reader.speaker: Vendeur
reader.fr: Oui. La sauce macha contient des cacahuètes.
reader.en: Yes. The macha sauce contains peanuts.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Dites-leur qu’elle a mangé ce taco il y a cinq minutes.
reader.en: Tell them she ate this taco five minutes ago.

reader.speaker: Ambulancier
reader.fr: Quel médicament a-t-elle utilisé, et à quelle heure ?
reader.en: Which medicine did she use, and at what time?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Elle a utilisé le médicament qu’elle portait dans son sac. Elle a mangé ce taco il y a cinq minutes.
reader.en: She used the medicine she carried in her bag. She ate this taco five minutes ago.

speaking.opening: Aidez-nous. Mon amie fait une réaction allergique.
speaking.goal: Tell the vendor that Elena has a peanut allergy and a tight throat, ask about her medicine, ask someone to call 112, and tell the ambulance worker what she ate and which medicine she used.
speaking.closure: Dites aux secours ce qu’elle a mangé et quel médicament elle a utilisé.
wordBank: Mon amie fait une réaction allergique.
Elle a mangé une bouchée de ce taco.
Dites aux secours ce qu’elle a mangé.
Tu as besoin de ton médicament ?
Elle a mangé ce taco il y a cinq minutes.
Elena a une allergie aux cacahuètes.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for an allergic reaction.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the direct request to call 112.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for a bite of food.

say.cueEnglish: Tell the vendor Elena is having an allergic reaction.

write.cueEnglish: Write what the responders should be told about the food.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Source reconciliation: restored peanut allergy, tight throat, medicine question, ambulance exchange and emergency number. The fictional scene is in France, where 112 is the European emergency number. Qualified French and emergency-domain review remains required; source clinical terms are direct in learner text.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: call the restaurant, describe the bag and table, and arrange to collect it
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You left your shopping bag under the table; call the restaurant, describe it, and arrange to pick it up.
lessons.title: Call About a Forgotten Shopping Bag
lessons.objective: Phone the restaurant, describe a forgotten shopping bag and table, and arrange when and where to collect it.
lessons.focus: Use j’ai oublié, sous la table, près de la fenêtre, vous l’avez trouvé and venir le récupérer to identify the item and pickup plan.
lessons.scene: Maya calls the bistro after leaving a blue canvas shopping bag under her lunch table.

cards.fr: J’ai oublié mon sac de courses.
Il était sous la table près de la fenêtre.
cards.en: It was under the table near the window.

cards.fr: Je peux venir le récupérer à quinze heures ?
cards.en: Can I come pick it up at three p.m.?
Can you keep it at the counter?

cards.fr: C’est un sac en toile bleue.
cards.en: It is a blue canvas bag.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Bonjour, le Bistrot Victor.
reader.en: Hello, Bistrot Victor.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. J’ai oublié mon sac de courses après le déjeuner.
reader.en: Hello. I forgot my shopping bag after lunch.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Pouvez-vous le décrire et me dire où vous étiez assise ?
reader.en: Can you describe it and tell me where you were seated?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: C’est un sac en toile bleue. Il était sous la table près de la fenêtre.
reader.en: It is a blue canvas bag. It was under the table near the window.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Vous étiez ici vers treize heures ?
reader.en: Were you here around one p.m.?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui. Vous l’avez trouvé ?
reader.en: Yes. Did you find it?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Oui, nous l’avons. Je le garde au comptoir.
reader.en: Yes, we have it. I will keep it at the counter.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Je peux venir le récupérer à quinze heures ?
reader.en: Thank you. Can I come pick it up at three p.m.?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.fr: Oui. Quel est votre nom ?
reader.en: Yes. What is your name?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Maya Martin. À tout à l’heure.
reader.en: Maya Martin. See you later.

speaking.opening: Bonjour. J’ai oublié mon sac de courses après le déjeuner.
speaking.goal: Describe the blue canvas bag, identify the window table and lunch time, confirm it was found and arrange pickup at the counter.
speaking.closure: Merci. Je passerai à quinze heures.
wordBank: J’ai oublié mon sac de courses.
Il était sous la table près de la fenêtre.
Je peux venir le récupérer à quinze heures ?
C’est un sac en toile bleue.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French word for a shopping bag.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to say under the table.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the question asking whether it was found.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French verb for to retrieve.

write.cueEnglish: Write a request to pick it up at three p.m.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The business name, found bag and pickup time are fictional scene details; review telephone register and confirmation sequence.
